spans.text: [4] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ EN: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.

[7] AR: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ EN: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire.

folded.id: whether you|were|truthful or were of the liars
folded.subject: whether you
folded.object: truthful or were of the liars

spans.text: [27] AR: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ EN: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.

folded.id: who|has|favored us over many of his believing servants
folded.subject: who
folded.object: favored us over many of His believing servants

spans.text: [15] AR: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ EN: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."

folded.id: why|do|i not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?

spans.text: [20] AR: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ EN: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
